About Sol y Mar Eco Farm

Sol y Mar Eco Farm is an agricultural learning site located in Barangay Namocon, Tigbauan, Iloilo. It promotes natural farming and sustainable agriculture. Visitors can explore the farm and appreciate the beauty of nature.


The eco-farm offers activities such as farm walks, organic agriculture learning, fruit and vegetable picking, bird watching, fishing, and boating, depending on availability.
